1.headline: Ukraine Hits a Russian Warship in Libya
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
A war reached a faraway port this week.
On Sunday, a Russian warship was hit in Libya. Libya is a country in North Africa. The ship was in the city of Benghazi. Some people had small injuries.
On Monday, Ukraine said it did this. Ukraine used seven sea drones. A sea drone is a small boat with no people. It carries a bomb.
Libya is very far from Ukraine. It is about 1,500 miles away. Before, Ukraine hit Russian ships mostly in the Black Sea. Now the war is going farther.
Again, Ukraine says its sea drones hit a Russian warship in Libya. Thank you for listening.

2.headline: Ukraine Says Its Sea Drones Hit a Russian Warship in Libya
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Can a war reach a port 1,500 miles away? This week, it did.

On Sunday, explosions hit a Russian warship in Benghazi, a city in eastern Libya. The ship was called the Merkury. It was one of Russia's newest warships. A photo from space later showed the ship lying on its side. Ten people had light injuries, according to medical sources.

On Monday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine did it. He said Ukraine used seven sea drones. A sea drone is a small boat with no one inside. It carries explosives and is controlled from far away. He said the drones also hit a Russian ship carrying weapons.
Russia said it had "taken note" of his words. Libya's eastern government said the ship stopped there for fuel. Now it is looking into the attack with Russia.
Why is this important? Ukraine has hit Russian ships before, mostly in the Black Sea. But Libya is very far from Ukraine. This shows the war is spreading to new places.
To sum up, Ukraine says its sea drones hit a Russian warship in Libya. Thank you for listening.

3.headline: Ukraine Says Its Sea Drones Struck a Russian Warship in Libya
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
How far can a war reach? This week, it reached a port in Libya, about 1,500 miles from the fighting in Ukraine.

On Sunday, explosions hit a Russian warship at a naval base in Benghazi, in eastern Libya. The ship was a corvette, which is a small, fast warship. It was called the Merkury, and it was one of Russia's newest ships. A satellite image later showed the ship turned over in the water. According to medical sources, ten Russians and Libyans had light injuries.

On Monday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine was behind the attack. He said Ukrainian forces used seven sea drones. A sea drone is a small boat with no one on board. It is full of explosives and is controlled from far away. Zelenskyy said the drones also hit a Russian cargo ship that carried weapons. He called it an exemplary operation, which means a model operation.

The Kremlin, Russia's government, said it had taken note of his statement. Libya's eastern government said the ship had stopped there for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia. It opened an investigation together with Russia.

Why does this matter? Ukraine has used sea drones against Russian ships many times, but mostly in the Black Sea. This attack shows the war can now reach places far from Ukraine. It also puts Libya, a country with two rival governments, in a difficult position.
To sum up, Ukraine says its sea drones hit a new Russian warship in Libya, far from the front line. Thank you for listening.

4.headline: Zelenskyy Says Ukrainian Naval Drones Struck Russian Corvette in Benghazi
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
Ukraine's war with Russia has reached the Mediterranean, roughly 1,500 miles from the front line, where one of Russia's newest warships was hit at a Libyan port.

On Sunday, a series of explosions tore through the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette commissioned in 2023, while it was docked at the naval base in Benghazi, in eastern Libya. Satellite imagery released afterward appeared to show the vessel capsized. Medical sources said ten people, both Russians and Libyans, suffered minor injuries.

On Monday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Kyiv was responsible, calling the strike an exemplary Ukrainian operation. He said seven Ukrainian-made naval drones were used, and that a cargo ship used to carry weapons was also hit, along with a Russian military helicopter. Ukraine's Security Service released videos it said showed the drones striking both vessels.

Libya's eastern-based government, which rivals the internationally recognized government in Tripoli, said the corvette had stopped in Benghazi for fuel and supplies under a cooperation agreement with Moscow and was heading back to Russia. It has opened a joint investigation with Russian officials. The Kremlin said only that it had taken note of Zelenskyy's statement. According to the Associated Press, Ukrainian forces have been operating in Libya under a covert arrangement.

The attack matters for several reasons. Ukraine has repeatedly used naval drones against Russian warships, but mostly in the Black Sea. Striking a vessel so far from home suggests the conflict is expanding into new waters, and it raises difficult questions for Libya, which is caught between rival powers. It also shows how cheap, unmanned boats are changing the way wars are fought at sea.
To sum up, Ukraine says its naval drones struck a new Russian warship in a Libyan port, far from the front line. Thank you for listening.

5.headline: Ukraine Takes Its Drone War to a Libyan Harbor
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
The war in Ukraine has surfaced in an unlikely theater: a Libyan harbor some 1,500 miles from the front line, as Kyiv's maritime campaign pushes into new waters.

On Sunday, the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that entered service in 2023 and ranks among the fleet's newest vessels, was rocked by multiple explosions while moored at the naval base in Benghazi. Satellite imagery taken that day appeared to show the ship capsized at its berth. Medical sources said ten people, Russian and Libyan, sustained minor injuries.

The following day, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed responsibility, hailing what he called an exemplary Ukrainian operation. By his account, seven domestically built naval drones carried out the strike, which also hit a cargo ship allegedly used to ferry weapons and destroyed a Russian military helicopter. Ukraine's Security Service released footage it said showed the drones closing in on both targets after being launched from a so-called mother ship.

The episode puts Libya in an awkward spot. The country remains split between a government in Tripoli, which is internationally recognized, and a rival administration based in the east. Benghazi authorities said the corvette had called at the port to refuel and take on supplies under a cooperation deal with Moscow before heading home, and they have launched a joint inquiry with Russia. The Kremlin, for its part, said merely that it had taken note of Zelenskyy's remarks. The Associated Press reported that Ukrainian forces have been operating in Libya under a covert arrangement.

Strategically, the strike is significant. Kyiv has used sea drones to devastating effect in the Black Sea, but hitting a warship in a distant port signals that it is willing and able to take the fight well beyond its own shores. It also underscores how inexpensive unmanned craft are upending traditional assumptions about naval power. Whether Russia will rethink how it protects its ships abroad remains to be seen.

To sum up, Ukraine says its naval drones struck one of Russia's newest warships in Benghazi, stretching the conflict far beyond its original battlefield and into the Mediterranean. Thank you for listening.

1.headline: Scientists Find a Very Old Light in Space
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Scientists saw something very, very old in space.
They found a very bright light far away. It is called a quasar. A quasar is the bright center of a galaxy. A big black hole is in the middle.
This quasar is very old. It formed 630 million years after the Big Bang. The Big Bang was the start of our universe. No one saw an older quasar before. It is a new record.
A space telescope named Euclid found it. Light from far away is old light. So we see the quasar from long, long ago.
Again, scientists found the oldest and farthest quasar ever. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
과학자들이 우주에서 아주아주 오래된 것을 보았습니다.
그들은 멀리서 아주 밝은 빛을 찾았습니다. 이것은 퀘이사라고 불립니다. 퀘이사는 은하의 밝은 중심입니다. 가운데에 커다란 블랙홀이 있습니다.
이 퀘이사는 아주 오래되었습니다. 빅뱅 후 6억 3천만 년 만에 생겨났습니다. 빅뱅은 우리 우주의 시작이었습니다. 전에는 아무도 이보다 오래된 퀘이사를 보지 못했습니다. 새로운 기록입니다.
유클리드라는 우주 망원경이 이것을 찾았습니다. 먼 곳에서 온 빛은 오래된 빛입니다. 그래서 우리는 아주 오래전의 퀘이사를 보는 것입니다.
다시 말해, 과학자들이 지금까지 가장 오래되고 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

2.headline: Scientists Find the Most Distant Quasar Ever
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
How far back in time can we see? Scientists just broke a record.

A team of scientists found the most distant quasar ever seen. A quasar is the very bright center of a galaxy. It shines because a huge black hole is eating gas and dust. This quasar formed about 630 million years after the Big Bang. The Big Bang was the start of our universe.
The scientists found it with Euclid, a European space telescope. Then other telescopes, like Hubble and Webb, checked the discovery. The black hole is about 360 million times heavier than our Sun.
Did you know? Light needs time to travel. So when we look far into space, we see the past. We see this quasar as it was 13.1 billion years ago.

Why is this exciting? The team leader said the jump back in time was huge. Scientists now wonder how the black hole grew so big so fast. He also said the record might fall again in a few months, or last for years.
To sum up, scientists found the most distant quasar ever, from very early in the universe. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
우리는 시간을 얼마나 멀리 거슬러 볼 수 있을까요? 과학자들이 방금 기록을 깼습니다.
한 과학자 팀이 지금까지 본 것 가운데 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 퀘이사는 은하의 아주 밝은 중심입니다. 거대한 블랙홀이 가스와 먼지를 먹어 치우기 때문에 빛이 납니다. 이 퀘이사는 빅뱅 후 약 6억 3천만 년 만에 생겨났습니다. 빅뱅은 우리 우주의 시작이었습니다.
과학자들은 유럽의 우주 망원경 유클리드로 이것을 찾았습니다. 그다음 허블과 웹 같은 다른 망원경들이 이 발견을 확인했습니다. 이 블랙홀은 태양보다 약 3억 6천만 배 무겁습니다.
알고 계셨나요? 빛이 이동하는 데는 시간이 걸립니다. 그래서 우주 먼 곳을 보면 과거를 보게 됩니다. 우리는 이 퀘이사의 131억 년 전 모습을 보고 있습니다.
이것이 왜 흥미로울까요? 팀을 이끈 과학자는 시간을 거슬러 올라간 폭이 아주 크다고 말했습니다. 과학자들은 이제 블랙홀이 어떻게 그렇게 빨리 그렇게 커졌는지 궁금해합니다. 그는 또 이 기록이 몇 달 만에 다시 깨질 수도 있고, 몇 년 동안 갈 수도 있다고 말했습니다.
정리하면, 과학자들이 아주 이른 시기 우주의 것인, 지금까지 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Scientists Spot the Most Distant Quasar Ever Seen
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
What if you could look back in time more than 13 billion years? Scientists just did, and they set a new record.

According to news reports, a team of scientists has found the most distant quasar ever seen. A quasar is the very bright center of a galaxy. It shines because a huge black hole in the middle is pulling in gas and dust. This quasar formed only about 630 million years after the Big Bang, the event that started our universe.

The team was led by Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory. They found the quasar in millions of observations from Euclid, a space telescope from the European Space Agency. Euclid went into space in 2023. Other telescopes, including Hubble and Webb, confirmed the discovery. Webb showed that the black hole is about 360 million times as heavy as our Sun.

Did you know? Light takes time to travel, so when we look very far away, we also look back in time. We see this quasar as it was 13.1 billion years ago. At that time, the universe was less than 5 percent of its age today.

Why is this interesting? Wolf said the jump in time is huge. He said it is the biggest step in nearly ten years. Scientists now want to know how a black hole grew so big so fast. Wolf also gave the quasar a fun nickname, Dun Aonghasa, after an old stone fort in Ireland. He said the record could fall in a few months, or it could last for years.
To sum up, scientists found the most distant quasar ever, from just 630 million years after the Big Bang. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
130억 년이 넘는 과거를 들여다볼 수 있다면 어떨까요? 과학자들이 방금 그 일을 해냈고, 새 기록도 세웠습니다.
보도에 따르면 한 과학자 팀이 지금까지 관측된 것 가운데 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 퀘이사는 은하의 아주 밝은 중심입니다. 가운데에 있는 거대한 블랙홀이 가스와 먼지를 끌어당기면서 빛이 납니다. 이 퀘이사는 우리 우주를 시작한 사건인 빅뱅 후 겨우 약 6억 3천만 년 만에 생겨났습니다.
이 팀은 유럽남방천문대의 율리안 볼프가 이끌었습니다. 연구팀은 유럽우주국의 우주 망원경 유클리드가 모은 수백만 건의 관측 자료에서 이 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 유클리드는 2023년에 우주로 갔습니다. 허블과 웹을 비롯한 다른 망원경들이 이 발견을 확인했습니다. 웹 망원경은 이 블랙홀이 태양보다 약 3억 6천만 배 무겁다는 것을 보여 주었습니다.
알고 계셨나요? 빛이 이동하는 데는 시간이 걸리기 때문에, 아주 먼 곳을 보면 과거도 함께 보게 됩니다. 우리는 이 퀘이사의 131억 년 전 모습을 보고 있습니다. 그때 우주의 나이는 지금의 5퍼센트도 되지 않았습니다.

이것이 왜 흥미로울까요? 볼프는 시간을 거슬러 올라간 폭이 아주 크다고 말했습니다. 거의 10년 만에 가장 큰 진전이라고 했습니다. 과학자들은 이제 블랙홀이 어떻게 그렇게 빨리 그렇게 커졌는지 알고 싶어 합니다. 볼프는 이 퀘이사에 아일랜드의 옛 돌 요새 이름을 딴 '둔 엥거스'라는 재미있는 별명도 붙였습니다. 그는 이 기록이 몇 달 만에 깨질 수도 있고, 몇 년 동안 이어질 수도 있다고 말했습니다.
정리하면, 과학자들이 빅뱅 후 겨우 6억 3천만 년 만에 생긴, 지금까지 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾았습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

4.headline: Euclid Telescope Helps Find the Most Distant Quasar on Record
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
Astronomers have spotted the most distant quasar ever found, a cosmic beacon that formed just 630 million years after the Big Bang.

A quasar is the brilliant core of a galaxy, powered by a supermassive black hole that is swallowing surrounding gas. The German-led team, headed by Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory, announced the discovery on Tuesday. The researchers sifted through millions of observations from the European Space Agency's Euclid telescope, which launched in 2023 to study dark matter and dark energy. Follow-up observations from the Hubble and Webb space telescopes backed up the result, and Webb data showed the central black hole weighs about 360 million times as much as the Sun.

Because light takes time to cross the universe, astronomers are seeing the quasar as it was 13.1 billion years ago, when the cosmos was less than 5 percent of its current age of 13.8 billion years. The findings were published in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics.

Wolf said the leap in cosmic time is huge. He noted that the two previous records each pushed the frontier back by about 15 million years or less, while this one moves it back by nearly 40 million years, which he called the biggest advance in nearly a decade. The discovery also deepens a puzzle: how could a black hole grow so massive so quickly?

On a lighter note, Wolf nicknamed the quasar Dun Aonghasa, after a prehistoric stone fort on Ireland's Aran Islands. His wife and daughter are Irish. As for how long the record will last, he admitted it could fall again within months or stand for years.
To sum up, astronomers using Euclid have found the earliest known quasar, offering a new glimpse of the young universe. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
천문학자들이 지금까지 발견된 것 가운데 가장 먼 퀘이사를 찾아냈습니다. 빅뱅 후 겨우 6억 3천만 년 만에 생겨난 우주의 등대입니다.

퀘이사는 은하의 눈부신 중심부로, 주변 가스를 집어삼키는 초대질량 블랙홀이 에너지를 공급합니다. 유럽남방천문대의 율리안 볼프가 이끄는 독일 주도 연구팀은 화요일에 이 발견을 발표했습니다. 연구팀은 암흑 물질과 암흑 에너지를 연구하려고 2023년에 발사된 유럽우주국의 유클리드 망원경이 모은 수백만 건의 관측 자료를 꼼꼼히 살폈습니다. 허블과 웹 우주 망원경의 후속 관측이 이 결과를 뒷받침했고, 웹의 자료는 중심 블랙홀의 무게가 태양의 약 3억 6천만 배라는 것을 보여 주었습니다.
빛이 우주를 가로지르는 데 시간이 걸리기 때문에, 천문학자들은 이 퀘이사의 131억 년 전 모습을 보고 있습니다. 그때 우주의 나이는 현재 나이인 138억 년의 5퍼센트도 되지 않았습니다. 이 연구 결과는 학술지 '천문학과 천체물리학'에 실렸습니다.
볼프는 우주의 시간을 거슬러 올라간 폭이 아주 크다고 말했습니다. 그는 앞선 두 기록이 각각 한계를 약 1,500만 년 이하만큼 뒤로 밀었던 반면, 이번에는 거의 4천만 년을 밀어냈다며, 거의 10년 만에 가장 큰 진전이라고 했습니다. 이 발견은 블랙홀이 어떻게 그렇게 빨리 그렇게 거대해질 수 있었는지에 대한 수수께끼도 더 깊게 만듭니다.
가벼운 이야기를 하자면, 볼프는 이 퀘이사에 아일랜드 애런 제도의 선사 시대 돌 요새 이름을 따서 '둔 엥거스'라는 별명을 붙였습니다. 그의 아내와 딸이 아일랜드 사람입니다. 기록이 얼마나 오래갈지에 대해서는, 몇 달 안에 다시 깨질 수도 있고 몇 년 동안 유지될 수도 있다고 인정했습니다.
정리하면, 유클리드를 활용한 천문학자들이 지금까지 알려진 가장 이른 시기의 퀘이사를 찾아, 어린 우주를 새롭게 엿볼 수 있게 되었습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

5.headline: Euclid Pushes the Cosmic Frontier Back With a Record-Breaking Quasar
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
Astronomers have pushed the edge of the observable past back by a remarkable margin, identifying a quasar that blazed into existence a mere 630 million years after the Big Bang.

Quasars are the dazzling hearts of galaxies, lit up by supermassive black holes as they gorge on surrounding gas. The newly identified object, the most distant of its kind on record, was unveiled on Tuesday by a German-led team under Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory. The researchers combed through millions of observations gathered by the European Space Agency's Euclid telescope, a mission launched in 2023 chiefly to probe the nature of dark matter and dark energy. Subsequent observations by the Hubble and Webb space telescopes corroborated the find, with Webb pinning the black hole's mass at roughly 360 million times that of the Sun.

Because light travels at a finite speed, the quasar appears as it did 13.1 billion years ago, when the universe was less than 5 percent of its present age of 13.8 billion years. The results appear in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics.

What makes the discovery stand out is the size of the jump. According to Wolf, each of the two preceding records nudged the frontier back by roughly 15 million years or less, whereas this one leaps back nearly 40 million years, which he described as the biggest advance in close to a decade. Only months earlier, in July, Euclid had revealed quasars dating to about 670 million years after the Big Bang. The finding sharpens a long-standing riddle: how could a black hole bulk up to such a colossal size in so little time?

There is a whimsical touch, too. Wolf dubbed the object Dun Aonghasa, after a prehistoric clifftop fort on Ireland's Aran Islands, a nod to his Irish wife and daughter. And he is refreshingly candid about its staying power, conceding that the record could tumble within months or hold for years.
To sum up, Euclid has helped uncover the earliest quasar yet, giving astronomers a sharper window onto the infant universe and a fresh cosmic mystery to solve. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
천문학자들이 관측 가능한 과거의 경계를 눈에 띄게 뒤로 밀어냈습니다. 빅뱅 후 겨우 6억 3천만 년 만에 빛을 내기 시작한 퀘이사를 찾아낸 것입니다.

빛의 속도는 유한하기 때문에, 이 퀘이사는 131억 년 전의 모습으로 보입니다. 그때 우주의 나이는 현재 나이인 138억 년의 5퍼센트도 되지 않았습니다. 연구 결과는 학술지 '천문학과 천체물리학'에 실렸습니다.

이번 발견이 돋보이는 것은 그 도약의 크기 때문입니다. 볼프에 따르면 앞선 두 기록은 각각 한계를 약 1,500만 년 이하만큼 조금씩 밀어냈지만, 이번에는 거의 4천만 년을 단숨에 거슬러 올라갔으며, 그는 이를 거의 10년 만의 가장 큰 진전이라고 표현했습니다. 불과 몇 달 전인 7월에도 유클리드는 빅뱅 후 약 6억 7천만 년 무렵의 퀘이사들을 찾아낸 바 있습니다. 이번 발견은 오래된 수수께끼를 더욱 뚜렷하게 만듭니다. 블랙홀이 어떻게 그렇게 짧은 시간에 그토록 거대해질 수 있었을까요?
재미있는 이야기도 있습니다. 볼프는 아일랜드 애런 제도의 절벽 위 선사 시대 요새 이름을 따서 이 천체를 '둔 엥거스'라고 불렀는데, 아일랜드 출신인 아내와 딸을 생각한 것입니다. 그리고 그는 기록이 얼마나 갈지에 대해 솔직하게, 몇 달 안에 깨질 수도 있고 몇 년 동안 유지될 수도 있다고 인정했습니다.
정리하면, 유클리드가 지금까지 가장 이른 시기의 퀘이사를 찾는 데 힘을 보태, 천문학자들은 갓 태어난 우주를 더 선명하게 들여다보게 되었고 풀어야 할 새로운 우주의 수수께끼도 얻었습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

items.ko: 빅뱅 직후 가장 먼 퀘이사 발견

1.headline: Korea May Get Its First Woman Spy Chief
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Korea may get its first woman spy boss.
On Monday, President Lee Jae Myung picked new people. They will work on safety and other countries. One job is the head of the spy agency. Lee picked Kang Kum-sil for it.
Kang was a judge before. She was also Korea's first woman justice minister. She led the justice ministry. No woman led the spy agency before.
Lee also picked a new foreign minister. He picked other new ministers too. Lawmakers will ask them questions first.
Again, Korea may soon have its first woman spy chief. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
한국에 처음으로 여성 정보기관 수장이 생길지도 모릅니다.
월요일에 이재명 대통령이 새로운 사람들을 골랐습니다. 이들은 안보와 다른 나라와의 관계를 맡게 됩니다. 그 가운데 하나는 정보기관의 수장 자리입니다. 이 대통령은 이 자리에 강금실 씨를 골랐습니다.
강 씨는 전에 판사였습니다. 또 한국의 첫 여성 법무부 장관이었습니다. 법무부를 이끌었습니다. 전에는 정보기관을 이끈 여성이 없었습니다.
이 대통령은 새 외교부 장관도 골랐습니다. 다른 새 장관들도 골랐습니다. 국회의원들이 먼저 이들에게 질문을 하게 됩니다.
다시 말해, 한국에 곧 첫 여성 정보기관 수장이 생길 수 있습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

2.headline: President Lee Picks a Woman to Lead Korea's Spy Agency
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Could a woman lead Korea's spy agency for the first time? It may happen soon.

On Monday, President Lee Jae Myung changed his foreign affairs and security team. He chose Kang Kum-sil to lead the National Intelligence Service. This is Korea's spy agency. If she is approved, she will be the first woman in this job.
Kang was a judge before. Years ago, she became Korea's first female justice minister. She also helped Lee in his election campaigns.

Lee picked other new ministers, too. Lim Woong-soon, a longtime diplomat, will be the new foreign minister. Hong Ihk-pyo was picked to handle relations with North Korea. A lawmaker and a presidential spokesperson also got new jobs.
Why is this important? These people will shape how Korea works with the United States and North Korea. First, lawmakers will ask them questions at special meetings called hearings.
To sum up, President Lee picked new security leaders, and Korea may get its first female spy chief. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
처음으로 여성이 한국의 정보기관을 이끌 수 있을까요? 곧 그렇게 될지도 모릅니다.
월요일, 이재명 대통령이 외교안보 팀을 바꿨습니다. 그는 국가정보원을 이끌 사람으로 강금실 씨를 골랐습니다. 국가정보원은 한국의 정보기관입니다. 강 씨가 승인을 받으면 이 자리에 오르는 첫 여성이 됩니다.
강 씨는 전에 판사였습니다. 오래전 그는 한국의 첫 여성 법무부 장관이 되었습니다. 또 이 대통령의 선거 운동을 도왔습니다.
이 대통령은 다른 새 장관들도 골랐습니다. 오랜 외교관인 임웅순 씨가 새 외교부 장관이 됩니다. 홍익표 씨는 북한과의 관계를 맡을 사람으로 뽑혔습니다. 국회의원 한 명과 대통령실 대변인도 새 자리를 맡았습니다.
이것이 왜 중요할까요? 이 사람들은 한국이 미국, 북한과 어떻게 일할지를 결정하게 됩니다. 먼저 국회의원들이 청문회라는 특별한 회의에서 이들에게 질문을 합니다.
정리하면, 이 대통령이 새 안보 책임자들을 골랐고, 한국에 첫 여성 정보기관 수장이 생길 수 있습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Lee Changes His Security Team and Names a Woman as Spy Chief
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Who will lead Korea's spy agency? For the first time, it could be a woman.

On Monday, President Lee Jae Myung changed several top people in his foreign affairs and security team. His chief of staff, Lim Kwang-hyun, announced the new choices. The biggest news was about the National Intelligence Service, or NIS. This is Korea's spy agency. Lee chose Kang Kum-sil, a former justice minister, to lead it. If she is approved, she will be the first woman to head the agency.
Kang is a former judge. Under President Roh Moo-hyun, she became Korea's first female justice minister. She also led groups that supported Lee's election campaigns in 2021 and 2025.

Lee also named other new ministers. Lim Woong-soon, a career diplomat, was chosen as foreign minister. A career diplomat is someone who has worked as a diplomat for most of his working life. Hong Ihk-pyo, a former lawmaker, was picked as unification minister, the minister who handles relations with North Korea. Lawmaker Han Jun-ho, a former TV news anchor, was named interior minister. Presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung was named culture minister.

Why does this matter? These jobs shape how Korea deals with the United States and North Korea. According to reports, Seoul is now in talks with Washington on several big security issues, including nuclear-powered submarines. The nominees still need to go through hearings at the National Assembly. A hearing is a meeting where lawmakers ask them questions.
To sum up, President Lee changed his security team and picked Kang Kum-sil, who could become Korea's first female spy chief. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
한국의 정보기관은 누가 이끌게 될까요? 처음으로 여성이 될 수도 있습니다.
월요일, 이재명 대통령이 외교안보 팀의 고위직 여러 명을 바꿨습니다. 임광현 대통령 비서실장이 새 인선을 발표했습니다. 가장 큰 소식은 한국의 정보기관인 국가정보원, 즉 국정원에 관한 것이었습니다. 이 대통령은 전 법무부 장관인 강금실 씨를 국정원장으로 골랐습니다. 강 씨가 승인을 받으면 국정원을 이끄는 첫 여성이 됩니다.
강 씨는 판사 출신입니다. 노무현 대통령 시절 그는 한국의 첫 여성 법무부 장관이 되었습니다. 또 2021년과 2025년 이 대통령의 선거 운동을 지원한 조직을 이끌었습니다.

이 대통령은 다른 새 장관들도 지명했습니다. 직업 외교관인 임웅순 씨가 외교부 장관으로 뽑혔습니다. 직업 외교관이란 일하는 동안 대부분을 외교관으로 일해 온 사람을 말합니다. 전 국회의원 홍익표 씨는 북한과의 관계를 맡는 통일부 장관으로 뽑혔습니다. 텔레비전 뉴스 앵커 출신인 한준호 의원은 행정안전부 장관으로 지명되었습니다. 강유정 대통령실 대변인은 문화체육관광부 장관으로 지명되었습니다.
이것이 왜 중요할까요? 이 자리들은 한국이 미국, 북한과 어떻게 지낼지를 좌우합니다. 보도에 따르면 한국 정부는 지금 핵추진 잠수함을 비롯한 여러 큰 안보 문제를 놓고 미국 정부와 협의하고 있습니다. 후보자들은 아직 국회 청문회를 거쳐야 합니다. 청문회는 국회의원들이 후보자에게 질문하는 자리입니다.
정리하면, 이 대통령이 안보 팀을 바꾸고 강금실 씨를 지명했으며, 강 씨는 한국의 첫 여성 정보기관 수장이 될 수 있습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

4.headline: Lee Reshuffles Security Team, Taps Kang Kum-sil as First Female NIS Chief
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
South Korea could soon have its first female spy chief, after President Lee Jae Myung shook up his foreign policy and security team on Monday.

Lee nominated former Justice Minister Kang Kum-sil to head the National Intelligence Service, replacing Lee Jong-seok. If she is confirmed, Kang would become the first woman to lead the agency. A former Seoul High Court judge, Kang made history once before as the country's first female justice minister under President Roh Moo-hyun. She also chaired committees supporting Lee's presidential campaigns in 2021 and 2025.

The reshuffle, announced by presidential chief of staff Lim Kwang-hyun, reached several other key posts. Career diplomat Lim Woong-soon, currently the second deputy national security adviser and a former ambassador to Canada, was tapped as foreign minister, replacing Cho Hyun. Former three-term lawmaker Hong Ihk-pyo was named unification minister, Democratic Party lawmaker Han Jun-ho, a former television anchor, was picked to lead the interior ministry, and presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung was nominated as culture minister.

According to the chief of staff, the outgoing team had wrapped up tariff talks with the United States and contributed to the country's largest-ever current account surplus. The changes come as Seoul pursues negotiations with Washington on issues such as the transfer of wartime operational control, nuclear-powered submarines and a revision of the two countries' civil nuclear agreement.

The nominees still face confirmation hearings at the National Assembly, where lawmakers will question them on their records. Such hearings are standard for these posts, and they can sometimes delay appointments. Kang's nomination, in particular, would mark a milestone for women in Korea's national security posts.
To sum up, President Lee has reshaped his security lineup, and Kang Kum-sil could become South Korea's first female spy chief. Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
월요일 이재명 대통령이 외교안보 팀을 개편하면서, 한국에 곧 첫 여성 정보기관 수장이 탄생할 수도 있게 되었습니다.
이 대통령은 이종석 국정원장 후임으로 강금실 전 법무부 장관을 지명했습니다. 인준을 받으면 강 후보자는 국정원을 이끄는 첫 여성이 됩니다. 서울고등법원 판사 출신인 강 후보자는 노무현 대통령 시절 한국의 첫 여성 법무부 장관으로 이미 한 번 역사를 쓴 바 있습니다. 또 2021년과 2025년 이 대통령의 대선 운동을 지원한 위원회의 위원장을 맡았습니다.

임광현 대통령 비서실장이 발표한 이번 개편은 다른 주요 자리에도 미쳤습니다. 현재 국가안보실 2차장이자 주캐나다 대사를 지낸 직업 외교관 임웅순 씨가 조현 장관 후임 외교부 장관으로 발탁되었습니다. 3선 의원 출신 홍익표 씨는 통일부 장관으로, 방송 앵커 출신인 더불어민주당 한준호 의원은 행정안전부 장관으로, 강유정 대통령실 대변인은 문화체육관광부 장관으로 지명되었습니다.
비서실장에 따르면 물러나는 팀은 미국과의 관세 협상을 마무리하고, 사상 최대 경상수지 흑자에 기여했습니다. 이번 교체는 한국 정부가 전시작전통제권 전환, 핵추진 잠수함, 한미 원자력 협정 개정 같은 문제를 놓고 미국 정부와 협상을 이어 가는 가운데 이루어졌습니다.
후보자들은 아직 국회 인사청문회를 거쳐야 하며, 국회의원들은 그 자리에서 이들의 이력을 묻게 됩니다. 이런 청문회는 이 직책들에 늘 따르는 절차이며, 때로는 임명을 늦추기도 합니다. 특히 강 후보자의 지명은 한국 국가안보 분야 여성들에게 하나의 이정표가 될 것입니다.
정리하면, 이 대통령이 안보 진용을 새로 짰고, 강금실 씨는 한국의 첫 여성 정보기관 수장이 될 수 있습니다. 들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

5.headline: Lee Overhauls His Security Lineup, Tapping Kang Kum-sil to Break the NIS Glass Ceiling
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
A glass ceiling at the heart of South Korea's security establishment may be about to shatter.

On Monday, President Lee Jae Myung unveiled a sweeping overhaul of his foreign policy and national security lineup, tapping former Justice Minister Kang Kum-sil to take the helm of the National Intelligence Service in place of Lee Jong-seok. Should she clear the confirmation process, Kang would be the first woman ever to run the country's spy agency. It would not be her first breakthrough: a former Seoul High Court judge, she became South Korea's first female justice minister under the late President Roh Moo-hyun, and she has long been a close ally of Lee, chairing committees that backed his presidential bids in 2021 and 2025.

The shake-up, announced by presidential chief of staff Lim Kwang-hyun, extends well beyond the spy agency. Lim Woong-soon, a seasoned diplomat who serves as second deputy national security adviser and once held the post of ambassador to Canada, was nominated to succeed Cho Hyun as foreign minister. Hong Ihk-pyo, a former three-term lawmaker and onetime floor leader of the Democratic Party, was named unification minister, while Democratic lawmaker and ex-broadcaster Han Jun-ho and presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung were put forward for the interior and culture portfolios, respectively.

The chief of staff credited the departing team with concluding tariff negotiations with the United States and helping deliver the country's largest-ever current account surplus. The new lineup takes over at a delicate juncture, as Seoul presses Washington on a raft of thorny issues, from the transfer of wartime operational control to nuclear-powered submarines and a revision of the bilateral civil nuclear pact.

All of the nominees must still run the gauntlet of parliamentary confirmation hearings, which have been known to stall or even sink appointments. Even so, Kang's nomination marks a symbolic milestone in a field that has long been dominated by men.
To sum up, President Lee has overhauled his diplomatic and security team, and Kang Kum-sil stands poised to become South Korea's first female intelligence chief. Thank you for listening.
